title: Salt Dragons Dream Nicotine Salt E-Liquid
description: A tropical e-juice with a mouth-watering twist, Dragon’s Dream takes the mellow sweetness of exotic dragonfruit and layers over tangy, sweet blueberry for a perfectly balanced, and utterly delicious vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
